name: Insight
description: Validated analytics agent for CSV/Excel. LLMs plan - as a JSON plan or a bounded tool-calling loop - while deterministic pandas/scipy/DuckDB computes and re-verifies every number. No arbitrary code execution: the model only selects audited operations.

paragraphs: Upload a CSV — or four related ones. Ask anything in plain English. Get verified answers, newspaper-styled charts, a formatted Word report, and production-ready dbt and alert exports.
features: Zero-prompt briefing — the moment a CSV lands, deterministic detectors surface the three most important findings (trend breaks, outliers, strong correlations, class imbalance, data quality), each with an Investigate…

Next-best-action suggestions — insight/agentic.py derives follow-up questions from the profile, what you've already analyzed, and columns shared across tables. Zero LLM cost, zero latency; the UI renders them as…

Agentic tool-use mode (opt-in) — the model calls analysis ops as tools one at a time, reads each real computed result, and decides what to do next. Bounded, throttle-aware, identical-failure abort, DAG-chained via…

Verified answers — a validator checks sanity and small-sample caveats; an independent recomputation layer re-derives aggregates through a second code path and flags any mismatch before you see the answer.

Statistical tests without statistics mistakes — binary-vs-numeric questions route to Welch's t-test or Mann–Whitney U with Cohen's d and plain-language group differences ("Class 1 averages 32% lower"); categorical pairs…

requirements.text: Every query must carry the user's own provider key.

The offline unit/integration suite covers the profiler, every analytics operation (including statistical routing), the DAG executor, the validator + independent recomputation layer, planner repair loops, chart rendering rules, the briefing engine, conversation state, the query cache, text streaming, plan approval, prompt-cache stability, BYOK enforcement, and the FastAPI…
